How Cloudflare handles TLS

Termination happens at the edge, which is the part people find surprising the first time they look at it. The certificate the browser sees is not the certificate the origin holds, and the two are negotiated independently for reasons that are mostly historical but turn out to matter a great deal in practice.

How the handshake works

The client hello arrives at whichever edge node is closest, and everything after that is a question of which keys that node is allowed to hold on your behalf. Read the related write-up for the longer version of this story.
